name: application-fleet-status-grid
title: Fleet Status Grid
description: Vehicle tile grid with active/idle/maintenance status pills and assigned driver, driven by a typed vehicles prop contract.
useWhen: Logistics or delivery dashboards need an at-a-glance overview of many vehicles' current status.
Each vehicle has a driver assignment (or lack thereof) worth surfacing alongside its status.
Vehicles fall into a small set of states (active, idle, maintenance) that benefit from consistent status pills.
avoidWhen: You need service-level infrastructure health rather than physical vehicles — use the Health Check Grid instead.
Only one vehicle needs tracking — a single detail card is simpler than a grid.
Real-time location matters more than status — pair this grid with (or replace it with) a live map view.
responsiveBehavior: The grid uses 2 columns on narrow viewports and 3 columns from the sm breakpoint up; each tile keeps intrinsic sizing so it reflows cleanly at any grid width.
accessibility: Status pills pair a color dot with an explicit text label ('Active', 'Idle', 'Maintenance'), never color alone.
The vehicle icon at the top of each tile is decorative (aria-hidden); the label and driver text carry the actual identifying information.
Unassigned vehicles show 'Unassigned' as visible text rather than leaving the driver line blank, avoiding ambiguity.

variants.title: Fleet Status Grid
variants.description: Responsive tile grid with a vehicle icon, status pill (active/idle/maintenance), vehicle label, and assigned driver per tile.
accessibility: Each status pill's color is reinforced by an explicit text label so status is never communicated by color alone.

variants.title: Fleet Status Grid (Dark)
variants.description: Vehicle status grid adapted for dark surfaces with the same icon, status-pill, and driver-label structure.
accessibility: Status pill colors and tile text must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark surfaces.
